The '''Falko system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] known as the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system shared its name with the [[Falko Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Antipose system/Legends|Antipose system]] and the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Uaua/Legends|Uaua]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Falko system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square U-8.<ref name="TEA" />
